deadline.value: LTH advertises doctoral positions throughout the year, with no fixed application date.
deadline.quote: LTH does not apply fixed application times, but a doctoral position can be advertised at any time throughout the year

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned for LTH computer science.

supervisor.value: The LTH pages set no rule on supervisor agreement before admission.

funding.value: LTH says the most common route is employment as a doctoral student, and funding must be secured for the whole education.
funding.quote: The most common form of funding is through employment as a doctoral student

also.quote: For you to be enrolled as a doctoral student, funding is required for your entire education

entry_route.value: Entry needs a second-cycle qualification or 240 credits including 60 at second-cycle level, plus at least 60 second-cycle credits at an advanced level relevant to the topic.
entry_route.quote: has been awarded a second-cycle qualification

notes: No separate data science, ML or AI PhD programme was found on official pages; the computer science syllabus lists artificial intelligence as one example area, so no datasci record was created.
